transcription_notes: Hand: regular upright Ethiopic book hand, 3 columns/page, dense, with heavy red rubrication of clause-initial words/divine names in the running text and red cross-shaped (✣) clause dividers. Verses NOT numbered; segmented by ✣ dividers + narrative sense, numbered 1-21. CAUTION (structural): the red ✣ ክፍል ፡ N ✣ rubrics are FINE LITURGICAL SUBDIVISIONS, not modern chapters — multiple ክፍል markers fall inside this single modern chapter 3 (seen repeatedly on both folios) and their numerals climb fast; they were therefore NOT used to bound the chapter and are stripped from tokens like any rubric. Chapter bounded by narrative only. Modern ch.2->3 START: on f106v COLUMN 3 (≈line 14 of col3): modern ch.2 ends with the man-of-God prophecy '...ግድፈኒ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አሐቲ ፡ እምነ ፡ ካህናቲከ ኝብ ፡ እበልዕ ፡ እክለ' (that I may eat a piece of bread, = 1Sa 2:36), then a red ✣ክፍл✣ rubric, then ch.3 v.1 begins 'ወዝንቱስ ፡ ወልዲ ፡ ሰሙኤл ፡ ሀለወ ፡ ይትለአኮ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ቅድመ ፡ ኤሊ ፡ ካህን ፡ ወክቡር ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ነገረ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ በእማንቱ ፡ መዋዕል ፡ ወአልቦ ፡ ራእይ ዘይከውን' — i.e. exactly 'the child Samuel was ministering to the LORD before Eli the priest, and precious/rare was the word of the LORD in those days, and there was no vision' (the sanctioned skeleton for v.1). The chapter then runs through the threefold call ('Samuel, Samuel'; Samuel running to Eli 'here am I'; Eli perceiving the LORD calls the boy; 'Speak LORD for thy servant heareth'), continuing from the bottom of f106v col3 (ends mid-v.10/start v.11 '...✣ ወይቤሎ') onto f107r COLUMN 1 top, then the judgment-prophecy on the house of Eli (iniquity not purged by sacrifice for ever), morning/Samuel opening the doors and afraid, Eli's adjuration, Samuel telling all, Eli 'It is the LORD', Samuel grew with the LORD letting none of his words fall, all Israel from Dan to Beersheba knowing Samuel a prophet, and the LORD appearing again in Shiloh.
